method: Enumerated exact release blobs with git ls-tree -r -z. Compared each non-audit working file using the Git blob hash of its bytes. Also checked non-ignored extra files against the release path set. Did not use the working index for content comparison.
excludedEvidenceScope: All paths under docs/audits/ were excluded from this light source and operations comparison. Launch evidence was still being written; historical archive integrity was not rechecked here.
note: Source, configuration, application assets, tests, and operations documents matched the release at this check. The final evidence commit still requires an exact-commit scan after all writers finish. No blob contents, secret values, or private paths are included.
